name: Non Compos Mentis
source:
It's October 31st, 1972. In the small town of Edinna, university students Steph and Nat are lured by the call of a centuries-old curse on the remains of a nobleman. 

[From [url=https://pistachiosu.itch.io/non-compos-mentis]itch.io[/url]]
